candidates.name: RBL Bank BankBazaar SaveMax Pro

Brief rule 4 says invite-only is not drafted. If a person wants it catalogued for existing holders, the sourced facts are: fee INR 1,499 first year and later (SOC, MITC; no waiver); Mastercard only (network guide); 10 points per INR 100 on grocery and 5 per INR 100 on fuel, each capped at 1,000 points a month, 2 points per INR 100 base, excluded categories as in SaveMax but fuel is not excluded from the 5x (T&C 3.3); welcome 5,000 points on a transaction within 30 days plus fee paid (T&C 3.4); milestones 2,000 points at INR 2 lakh and a further 4,000 at INR 4 lakh a year (T&C 3.5); 10% BookMyShow up to INR 100 monthly and 10% Zomato up to INR 100 monthly. T&C file is named sept-22 and was created 18 Dec 2025.

candidates.name: RBL Bank Popcorn
candidates.reason: Replaced/transitioned. RBL's Popcorn page opens with: 'With effect from December 20, 2025, your existing RBL BookMyShow Popcorn Credit Card will be transitioned. For complete details, please refer to the email sent on your registered mail address.' Its banner promotes the RBL Bank Play Credit Card instead, and the card list shows 'Know more' only with no Apply Now. No other BookMyShow-family page (Fun+, Blockbuster, Movies & More) carries a transition notice. Caveat: the SOC, MITC and the Jan 2026 BookMyShow guide still list Popcorn for existing holders, and the card has no published points rate anyway (it earns monthly BookMyShow tickets, INR 25 weekly cashback and a fuel surcharge waiver of INR 100 a month, fee INR 1,000, Mastercard), so under brief rule 5 it would be 'held' even if sold.
